features: WIRELESS CONNECTIVITY: Bluetooth-enabled portable speaker with 10 metres range for seamless pairing with smartphones, tablets, and other Bluetooth-compatible devices
COMPACT DESIGN: Ultra-mini round speaker with heavy metal electroplated multicolour finish, weighing only 70 grams and measuring 2 cm width x 1 cm height, perfect for on-the-go use
POWERFUL AUDIO: Features bass boost technology with 10 watts output, 5 cm dynamic driver, and 2.0 stereo sound configuration for rich audio quality despite its compact size
LONG BATTERY LIFE: Equipped with rechargeable battery offering extended playtime with quick charge capability, plus convenient touch control power button for easy operation
PORTABLE AND VERSATILE: Water-resistant indoor speaker with no assembly required, ideal for portable audio use at home, office, or whilst travelling
description: Sleek round design with heavy metal electroplated finish gives this mini wireless speaker a premium look and feel. Compact size with stylish multicolor variants makes it perfect for desks, travel, and everyday use while enhancing your setup aesthetically. The CNC turbo sound structure combines a reinforced metal cavity with a refined diaphragm and drive unit layout. This design supports improved bass response and clearer sound output while maintaining durability and compact size.
